product_summary: Sole proprietorship (per own site) in Panchkula, Haryana, incepted 2010, owner Manoj Bataan (Food Scientist). Declared plant capacity 5 lakh litres. Three real product families: (1) fruit-brewed vinegars — organic ACV with mother, organic ACV with amla/turmeric/cinnamon/black pepper, organic pomegranate vinegar, organic jamun vinegar, conventional ACV with mother, ACV with natural honey, ACV with ginger-garlic-lemon-honey, ACV with ginger & turmeric, red wine vinegar, jamun vinegar with mother, filtered natural ACV, white vinegar; (2) herbal juices — pulpy aloe vera, wheatgrass, noni gold, amla, karela jamun, noni, sea buckthorn, mix berry, plus ~10 named 'care' blends; (3) natural honey. Also offers private label, bottling and labelling services. Source: https://briovinegars.com (homepage, product menus).
role_hint: manufacturer (self-declared sole proprietorship with in-house plant, R&D, QC and bottling; no trader/reseller language on site). Not independently verified — no registry or customs check performed in this task.
comment: HS 2209.00 is CORRECT and covers the core line (all vinegars) — exact match on the dominant product family. HS 1302.19 is only PARTIALLY justified: 1302.19 is vegetable saps/extracts, whereas the site's non-vinegar lines are finished juices (2009.89 / 2009.90) and honey (0409.00), not extracts. So the declared pair under-represents the actual range: the entire herbal-juice portfolio (18+ SKUs) and natural honey have no declared code. Recommended correction: keep 2209.00 as primary, add 2009.89 and 2009.90 for the juice range, add 0409.00 for honey; retain 1302.19 only if extract-form sales are evidenced. Industry label 'Продукты питания и FMCG' is broadly right but imprecise — this is a beverage/fermented-condiment manufacturer, not general FMCG. Trader signs: none found; site describes own manufacturing, plant capacity and private-label/bottling services (a service line, not resale). All product claims are from the company's own website only — no customs line or third-party catalogue corroboration was obtained in this task, therefore the entire product list is 'заявлено, не подтверждено'. Note: IndiaMART page returned HTTP 429 and web search backend was unavailable, so no independent corroboration was possible. Per project rule 3, the HS mismatch is not a rejection ground — company retained, codes corrected.
